keys.note: open on the nausea (hand over mouth, eyes squeezed)
moving hold: drift + shallow quick breaths
anticipation: sharp little intake, shoulders up, head draws back
the heave: fast drop into the hunch, long settle
long calming inhale: chest lifts, head rises, lids soften
phew: exhale, hand slides down to the chest
eyes open, hand lands back on the bump
one slow stroke across the bump
